verdict_text:
YES

The script builds the keep index for one 2048-wide segment of 16 blocks of 128, skipping head 5, which yields rows 0..639 and 768..2047 in order. It applies that on dim 0 for q, k, v and on dim 1 for o_proj across all 16 layers, leaves every other tensor untouched, keeps names and dtypes, asserts the five required shape and count checks before writing, and saves a single model.safetensors with 114 tensors to out/T2. The only unverified piece is the helper load_checkpoint from the sibling _ckpt module, which is assumed to read the sharded input into a name-to-tensor dict.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
